newsitem.title: USA: Boston Technology added to S&P SmallCap.
newsitem.headline: Boston Technology added to S&P SmallCap.

text.p: Mark Twain Bancshares is being replaced on the S&P SmallCap 600 Index with Boston Technology after the close of trading April 25, Standard & Poor's said Friday.
Mark Twain Bancshares is being acquired by Mercantile Bancorp in a friendly stock merger scheduled to close April 25.

Boston Technology develops, makes and markets hardware and software products that provide enhanced voice, facsimile, and information processing services with multimedia capabilities over existing telephone and wireless networks.
S&P said it will add the Wakefield, Massachusetts-based company to its SmallCap 600 Communications Equipment industry group in the Technology economic sector.
